opening.argument: The offer is presented as a free iTunes gift card, with claimed values reaching $100, and viewers are directed to a purported generator rather than an ordinary purchase or clearly verifiable giveaway. The page visibly presents selectable denominations and a “Generate NOW” button, while the described process asks viewers to provide an email address. Receipt of the code is then conditioned on installing two apps and playing each for at least 30 seconds. Those features establish a low-barrier reward or asset-acquisition scheme, while the available evidence does not claim that viewers submitted data, installed apps, lost money, or received a working code.
